verdict.rationale: Cooley's labor and employment practice page explicitly claims experience 'representing companies and individuals in noncompete and trade secret litigation – and pursuing such claims for our clients,' and IP litigation stats show broad litigation volume, but there's no specific detail on confidentiality-program design, employee-mobility dispute processes, or dedicated trade-secret case studies/documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated trade-secret litigation case studies, confidentiality-program templates/tools, specific employee-mobility dispute examples, and independent corroboration.
